hypothesis: Clearance in microsomes and hepatocytes shares an observed metabolic component but different molecular contributions. Conditioning target on the residual of actual other-clearance measurement after a structural reference may transfer information without confusing raw scale, missingness and structure effects.
mechanism: Fresh structure-only kernel ridge on target and paired endpoint log1p labels. Three inner GroupKFold models per endpoint generate scaffold-OOF innovations; exclude outer query and inner hold groups from both reference label sources. Existing same-molecule target-excluded other endpoint measurements remain permitted context. beta=Cov(targetOOFresidual,otherOOFinnovation)/Var(otherOOFinnovation)*n/(n+20); centered other innovation;missing measurement gives zero innovation. No fit target labels in held prediction reference.
